_doc: Gates for bench/run_bench.py. 'spec' = absolute budgets; 'regression' = tolerances vs the reference tree. known_failures lists spec gates that fail at the time they were recorded (reported as XFAIL, never silently passed); remove an entry once its gate passes (the report flags it as XPASS).

factory.patch_first_voice.audible.note: Factory patch sets DUAL GATES to AC mode with GAIN = 0, which is a fixed -66 dB in DualGates::tick (kdB = -66*(1-g)); the envelope on LOG can only open the remaining 50 dB, so the patch peaks around -62 to -66 dBFS.

factory.patch_serge_bongos.audible.note: Exact digital silence: the second FILTER's only audio input is its own BAND output, so with zero initial state nothing ever excites it (the envelope only sweeps VC FREQ).
